    • editMap

      public void editMap(GameState p_gameState, String p_editFilePath) throws IOException
      Edits the map file associated with the game state. If the file doesn't exist, it creates a new file. If the file already exists, it loads the existing map from the file.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The current game state.
      p_editFilePath - The file path for the map to be edited or created.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs when creating the file.

    • saveMap

      public boolean saveMap(GameState p_gameState, String p_fileName) throws InvalidMap
      Saves the current map state to a file with the specified filename.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The current game state containing the map to be saved.
      p_fileName - The filename for the map file to be saved.
      Returns:
      True if the map was successfully saved, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      InvalidMap - If the map is found to be invalid during the save process.

      public void editContinent(GameState p_gameState, String p_argument, String p_operation) throws IOException, InvalidMap
